name: modal-dialog
title: Modal Dialog
description: A centered modal with focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus return, plus an alertdialog mode for confirmations. Fades without motion under reduced motion.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog asks to open or close (Escape, close button, backdrop).

props.name: footer
props.description: Buttons row at the bottom. Put data-autofocus on the button that should get focus.

props.name: role
props.description: alertdialog ignores clicks on the backdrop.

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Close when the backdrop is clicked.
